verdict.rationale: Workers deploy to Cloudflare's global network, so code runs near users by default, which covers the latency goal. The docs present this as having "no region complexity" rather than offering region selection. The only documented placement control, Smart Placement, moves Workers closer to data, not to chosen user regions. missing for 10: explicit ability to choose or pin specific deployment regions, documentation of regional deployment controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of user-proximity latency.
